testcases.name: personaplex-7b
testcases.l0_replacement_reason: PersonaPlex scale stays nightly; personaplex-7b-l0 keeps the speech path with shorter generation for PR L0.
testcases.notes: The temporal and depth decoders run in full FP32 while the Mimi codec remains FP16. Selectors 0 and 1 keep temporal embeddings, all 32 temporal blocks, KV caches, final norm, heads, and all 16 autoregressive depth decoders in FP32 with TF32 disabled; this stabilizes freshly selected TensorRT tactics while preserving the unchanged checkpoint-owned token contract.
